name: Microgrid failed-load-shed escalation
aliases: microgrids Microgrid load shedding and restoration
summary: Requests the documented fallback action when the assigned load disconnection is not confirmed.
description: Requests the documented fallback action when the assigned load disconnection is not confirmed. Load management balances the available electrical supply against the loads that remain connected. Shedding, restoration, priority and proof of disconnection are separate control functions and should remain traceable to individual load groups.

In a microgrid island, the controller can disconnect lower-priority loads when a source is lost and later request restoration when the documented reserve and stability conditions permit it. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Failed shedding feedback” at the input and “Fallback shedding request” at the output. Escalation scope must be defined.

Identify each load group, priority, measured contribution and feedback. Shedding amounts, operating times and restoration conditions require the approved power-management design and the actual connected-load data.
